preconditions.description: The number of lamps n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line must contain exactly n-1 integers, each between 1 and n inclusive, representing the main lamp indices for each wire.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) >= 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the scheme is impossible, output -1. Otherwise, output a valid scheme starting with the grid-connected lamp index k (1 ≤ k ≤ n), followed by n-1 lines of lamp pairs (x_i, y_i) representing wires.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and x != y for line in stdout.split()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Each wire must connect two distinct lamps within the valid range.
The output must contain exactly n-1 unique wires (no duplicates).
The grid-connected lamp index k must be within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: any(' '.join([str(x), str(y)]) in stdout.split()[1:] for x in range(1, n + 1) for y in range(1, n + 1) if x != y)
postconditions.description: The output must include all n-1 wires forming a connected tree (no isolated lamps).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a_i) <= n for a_i in stdin.split()[1:]) and (stdout.strip() != '-1')
postconditions.description: If a valid scheme exists, the output must correspond to a tree where the main lamp indices of wires, when sorted by descending importance, match the input sequence.
